title: How Prediction Markets and Crypto Firms Steamrolled a Watchdog Agency
partialText: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission purged its ranks, dialed back its enforcement and boosted industries in which President Trump’s family is heavily invested.

title: With Big Decisions Ahead, the Supreme Court Collides With a Testy Trump
partialText: President Trump has alternated between bullying the justices and cozying up to them as the court prepares to announce major decisions that will determine the fate of the key aspects of his agenda.

title: Do U.S. Automakers Have a Future in Canada?
partialText: Detroit-based automakers pioneered open trade between Canada and the United States, benefiting both countries. President Trump’s trade war now leaves their future in the country in question.

title: Rubio Says U.S.-India Ties Are Strong, Despite Fury Over Trump’s Actions
partialText: In New Delhi, Secretary of State Marco Rubio tried to explain why President Trump has pushed aggressive trade and immigration policies affecting India and Indians in the United States.

title: RFK Jr.’s Push to Curb Antidepressants Has Shaken Psychiatry
partialText: An annual psychiatric meeting was abuzz over Robert F. Kennedy Jr.’s call to rein in the use of depression medications. Some fear it will drive patients away from care.

title: Gunman in Shooting Near White House Killed in Exchange of Fire With Secret Service
partialText: A gunman known to the U.S. Secret Service opened fire near the White House and was shot and killed by federal officers. President Trump was in the White House at the time.

title: Trump Endorsement Shakes John Cornyn in Texas Senate Runoff Against Ken Paxton
partialText: A tough re-election race grew more daunting after President Trump backed Mr. Cornyn’s opponent, Ken Paxton. The Texas senator has vowed to fight to the end.

title: Sanders and Ocasio-Cortez Try Boosting Progressives in Red Districts
partialText: In highly competitive House races that Democrats need to flip in November, the left is betting that calls for universal health care and taxing the wealthy will resonate — even among Republicans.

title: A Deciding Factor in Congress Right Now: Who Shows Up to Vote
partialText: Vacant seats, and consistently poor attendance on both sides of the aisle, have exacerbated the challenges of already razor-thin margins in the House and Senate.

title: They Started I.V.F., Then Split. Now Who Gets Custody of the Embryos?
partialText: For 47-year-old Erin Millender, this will likely be her last chance to become a mother. Her husband no longer wants to have a child with her.

title: How Democrats Can Improve Their Odds, According to a Nobel Economist
partialText: An expert in human behavior explains how Democrats can change their primary process to improve their chances in 2028.

title: Trump’s Slush Fund Will Reward Criminals. Americans Will Pay for It.
partialText: The president’s corruption and subversion of democratic tradition risk becoming the norm.

title: Colbert’s Connection
partialText: A reflection on Stephen Colbert’s relationship with his audience.

title: At Least 14 Killed in Bombing Attack That Derailed a Train in Pakistan
partialText: The explosion was so powerful that several nearby buildings were damaged and a resident 15 miles away was jolted awake by the blast. A separatist group claimed responsibility.

title: Kyiv, Ukraine, Hit in Russian Missile Attack
partialText: Buildings rattled in the Ukrainian capital for hours early Sunday. Russia launched an Oreshnik intermediate-range ballistic missile for only the third time in the war.

title: New York’s Rape Laws Leave Out Many Victims Who Drank Willingly
partialText: Prosecutors say accusers who chose to drink or get high have a “very high burden” of proving they were physically helpless and unable to consent. There is a push to change the law.
